newsitem.title: USA: Nicollet Process to meet, beat Q1 revenue forecast.
newsitem.headline: Nicollet Process to meet, beat Q1 revenue forecast.

text.p: Nicollet Process Engineering Inc said Tuesday that revenues for the first quarter ended November 30 are expected to meet or exceed an analyst's forecast of $587,000.

"The trend of our revenues is encouraging. We expect first-quarter revenues to be considerably ahead of the $359,622 reported in the fourth quarter ended August 31, 1996," Robert Pitner, president, said in a statement.

He added that the company is "very encouraged" by industry acceptance of a new product for the die cast industry. Both the sale of this product and an analyzer product exceeded the company's revenue expectations for the quarter.
"In addition, we have initial orders for our new modular second generation Windows-based product for the plastic injection molding industry," Pitner said.
He said Nicollet is seeing growth in its overall backlog.
Nicollet designs and makes computing systems for automating the manufacturing process and supporting management-level decision support systems.
